SELECT 
    "China" AS country,
    year,
    SUM(CASE WHEN column = 'production' THEN value ELSE NULL END) AS total_production,
    SUM(CASE WHEN column = 'employment' THEN value ELSE NULL END) AS total_employment
FROM (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN T1.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 THEN 'China'
            WHEN T2.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 THEN 'India'
        END AS country,
        T1.year AS year,
        T1.column AS column,
        T1.value AS value
    FROM china_coal_production AS T1
    FULL JOIN china_employment AS T2 ON T1.year = T2.year
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN T1.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 THEN 'China'
            WHEN T2.year BETWEEN 2018 AND 2020 THEN 'India'
        END AS country,
        T1.year AS year,
        T1.column AS column,
        T1.value AS value
    FROM india_coal_production AS T1
    FULL JOIN india_employment AS T

```sql
SELECT 
```
```sql
    i.investor_name,
    SUM(i.is_shariah_compliant * j.investment_value) AS total_investment_value,
    CAST(SUM(i.is_shariah_compliant * j.investment_value) AS REAL) / SUM(j.investment_value) * 100 AS shariah_compliance_percentage
FROM 
    investors i
JOIN 
    investments j ON i.investor_id = j.investor_id
WHERE 
    i.country IN (
        SELECT 
            t1.country
        FROM 
            (SELECT 
                investor_id,
                country,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY investor_id ORDER BY SUM(is_shariah_compliant * investment_value) DESC) as rn
             FROM 
                 (SELECT 
                     investor_id,
                     country,
                     CASE WHEN is_shariah_compliant THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_shariah_compliant,
                     investment_value
                 FROM 
                     investments) t1
             GROUP BY 
                 investor_id, country
             ORDER BY 
                 SUM(is_shariah_compliant * investment_value) DESC
             LIMIT 5) t2
    )
GROUP BY 
    i.investor_name;
```

SELECT MIN(depth) FROM ocean_floor_mapping WHERE location = 'Mariana Trench';

SELECT name, mobile_contract_start_date, mobile_contract_end_date, broadband_contract_start_date, broadband_contract_end_date FROM subscribers WHERE mobile_contract_start_date <= broadband_contract_start_date AND mobile_contract_end_date >= broadband_contract_end_date;
SELECT word FROM news WHERE category = 'Politics' AND word_count = (SELECT MAX(word_count) FROM news WHERE category = 'Politics')
SELECT AVG(DEPTH) FROM TRENCHES WHERE REGION = 'Pacific Ocean' AND NAME IN ('Mariana Trench', 'Tonga Trench', 'Kuril-Kamchatka Trench', 'Philippine Trench', 'Sibuyan Sea Trench')
SELECT MAX(temp) FROM temps WHERE sensor_id = (SELECT sensor_id FROM sensors WHERE location = 'Field D')
SELECT MIN(price) FROM price_data WHERE element = 'Promethium' AND year BETWEEN 2016 AND 2018;

```sql
SELECT PropertyID, Price, SustainabilityScore, Neighborhood, Size
FROM Properties
WHERE Neighborhood = 'RenewableHeights'
ORDER BY SustainabilityScore DESC, Size ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

SELECT AVG(size) FROM property WHERE city = 'Seattle' AND co_owned = TRUE;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM threat_indicators WHERE sector = 'Energy' AND confidence > 75;
SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM Fabrics WHERE type IN ('Organic_Cotton', 'Recycled_Polyester') AND year = 2020;
SELECT gender, SUM(claim_amount) FROM claims JOIN policyholders ON claims.policyholder_id = policyholders.id GROUP BY gender;
SELECT COUNT(visitor_id) FROM visitor WHERE visitor_city = 'Seattle'
SELECT Plant, MAX(Volume) FROM WasteWaterTreatment WHERE Date = '2022-02-10' GROUP BY Plant
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM heart_rates WHERE day_type = 'Weekend' AND heart_rate > (SELECT AVG(heart_rate) FROM heart_rates WHERE day_type = 'Weekday')
